_comment: North Ayrshire Council ward roster. Alphabetical by surname — identical treatment for everyone, always. Party labels are stated as plain fact and CHURN MID-TERM (Ferguson was elected Conservative, sits as Reform UK) — the NAC website is the authoritative record; re-verify this file after any election, by-election or defection.
